    {"i": 6, "speaker": "bot", "text": "We have many good sellers available and I will connect you with the most suitable one shortly."},
    {"i": 7, "speaker": "bot", "text": "First I would just like to confirm a few details."},

    {"i": 10, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Third number."},
    {"i": 11, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Alright, let's talk about roller diameter now."},
    {"i": 12, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Which one would you like, 76 mm and 3 inch, 50 mm or something else?"},
    {"i": 13, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Twenty six."},
    {"i": 14, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Perfect."},
    {"i": 15, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Which roller length do you want like 600 mm, 2 feet, 300 mm or something else?"},
    {"i": 16, "speaker": "bot", "text": "nine hundred sixty."},
    {"i": 17, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Got it."},
    {"i": 18, "speaker": "caller", "text": "I can see you wanted HDP for material, right?"},
    {"i": 19, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Yes, I will do it."},
    {"i": 20, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Alright, I'll send you the seller details on WhatsApp where you can discuss the details and price directly."},
    {"i": 21, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Okay."},
    {"i": 22, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Thank you for choosing IndiaMART."},
    {"i": 23, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Have a nice day."},
    {"i": 24, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Thank you."}
  ]
